zh: 首演前夜的最后一次彩排。七点整，剧场的电子门禁出了故障，
所有门都锁死了，维修要到半夜才能赶来：谁也进不来，谁也出不去。
最后一次确认它还在箱子里，是 {seen}。
你是受邀来看彩排的退休侦探，在前厅的长椅上打了个盹，被人摇醒。
所有人都在休息室等你。
en: The last rehearsal before opening night. At seven o'clock the electronic door system at {setting} failed and locked every door. Repairs will not arrive until midnight: nobody gets in, nobody gets out.
At {found}, {client} returned to the prop room and found the {item} gone. It was last confirmed in its case during {seen}.
You are a retired detective invited to watch the rehearsal. You dozed off on a bench in the foyer, and someone shakes you awake. Everyone is waiting in the green room.

zh: 前厅 ── 观众席 ────── 侧台
化妆间 ── 后台走廊 ── 道具间 (现场)

persona.zh: 爱讲从前的事，一急就背台词。
persona.en: Loves old stories, slips into quoting lines when flustered.

persona.zh: 敏感挑剔，爱改别人的用词。
persona.en: Touchy and exacting, corrects other people's wording.

motive.zh: 剧本署名闹过纠纷，一直咽不下这口气。
motive.en: A dispute over the script credit still rankles.

persona.zh: 声音好听，说话带点戏腔。
persona.en: A fine voice, and a touch of the stage in every sentence.

motive.zh: 合约快到期，下一部戏还没着落。
motive.en: The contract is nearly up, with no next part in sight.

persona.en: Always checking the time, speaks like a countdown.

motive.zh: 工资已经拖欠了三个月。
motive.en: Three months of wages are still owed.

persona.zh: 寡言，爱盯着天花板想事情。
persona.en: Quiet, thinks with eyes on the ceiling.

motive.zh: 和团长为加班费吵过一架。
motive.en: Had a shouting match with the director over overtime.

persona.zh: 快人快语，爱打听别人的事。

motive.zh: 家里急用钱，这阵子到处在借。
motive.en: The family needs money fast, and borrowing has run out.

persona.en: Old-fashioned and slow of speech, full of how things used to be.

motive.zh: 当年把家传的东西卖给了团长，一直后悔。
motive.en: Once sold a family piece to the director, and has regretted it since.

motive.zh: 实习工资不够房租，转正又没指望。
motive.en: The stipend does not cover the rent, and no job is on offer.

persona.zh: 憨厚，手里总拿着工具，三句不离木头。
persona.en: Good-natured, tool in hand, always comes back to timber.

motive.zh: 还欠着木料行一大笔货款。
motive.en: Owes the timber yard a large sum.

text.zh: {client}手机里的照片：{time}，{item}还好好地放在道具间的箱子里。
text.en: A photo on {client}'s phone shows the {item} in its case in the prop room at {time}.

text.zh: 前厅的签到表上有{person}的名字，时间是 {time}。
text.en: The foyer sign-in sheet lists {person} at {time}.

text.zh: 观众席的灯光控制记录显示，{person}在 {time} 调过灯。
text.en: The house-light log shows {person} at the panel at {time}.

text.zh: 侧台的候场单上有{person}的记号，时间是 {time}。
text.en: The call sheet in the wings has {person}'s mark, timed {time}.

text.zh: 化妆间的镜子旁贴着{person}留的便条，落款时间 {time}。
text.en: A note by the dressing-room mirror, signed by {person}, is timed {time}.

text.zh: 休息室的咖啡机记录：{time}，{person}的工牌刷过一次。
text.en: The green-room coffee machine logged {person}'s badge at {time}.

text.zh: 装卸口的出入登记本上有{person}的签名，时间是 {time}。
text.en: The loading-dock register bears {person}'s signature, timed {time}.

text.zh: {person}的手机里有一张 {time} 在{location}拍的照片。
text.en: {person}'s phone holds a photo taken in the {location} at {time}.
